description.value: A Starbucks Coffee location in Sardis, part of the well-known international coffee chain. This outlet includes a drive-through lane, making it convenient for quick stops along Luckakuck Way. Touring cyclists passing through Chilliwack's commercial corridor will find it a familiar and reliable refuelling spot.
